text: 金十数据11月11日讯，近日，上海数智恒储能源科技有限公司成立，法定代表人为李晓迅，经营范围包含工业互联网数据服务、物联网技术研发、光伏发电设备租赁、人工智能基础软件开发、人工智能应用软件开发等。企查查股权穿透显示，该公司由阳光电源间接全资持股。
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 11 — Shanghai Shuzhi Hengchu Energy Technology Co., Ltd. was recently established, with Li Xiaoxun as legal representative. Its business scope includes industrial internet data services, IoT technology R&D, photovoltaic power generation equipment leasing, artificial intelligence basic software development, artificial intelligence application software development, and more. Qichacha equity penetration shows that the company is indirectly wholly owned by Sungrow.
